resolved_findings.title: Fresh CI check reads a historical attempt without checking the current run
Pause is not checked before each new subprocess/API read
Applied merges lose canonical receipt when the command reports a transport failure

verified_corrections: Fresh current run and attempt-1 state both require the exact head, current attempt 1, completion and success before named job checks.
Each ordinary command/API read checks the pause flag. The explicitly marked post-merge readback is bounded to recording the already-issued bundle operation; it issues no new mutation.
A confirmed applied merge records its canonical merge object/receipt even if the CLI exit is nonzero; the transport failure is retained and no retry is issued.
checks_without_findings: Exact head/tree/base/repository/worktree identity checks and writer lock verification are present.
Explicit normal merge uses --match-head-commit for954; no auto/admin/squash/rebase/delete flags or main/#12 mutation.
The helper records mark-ready and merge-command outcomes before subsequent work, and checks actual merge tree/parents.
limits: Static review and AST parse only; helper not executed and no merge decision authored by this reviewer.
Execution still requires the completed exact hosted receipt and a controller decision binding its real hashes and both job checkout observations. The controller owns that judgment.
Current helper hash and reviewed head/tree/base must remain unchanged; changed code or evidence bindings need scoped recheck.
The helper checks the base before and after a normal GitHub merge; controller ownership must keep the integration base stable during the operation.
The user usage-reset stop condition remains active.
